title: Scan invariant of the zero-prefixing machine
statement: For every pair of binary words $w,x$ and every natural number $t\le |x|$, after $t$ steps from its initial configuration on input $x$, the machine defined from $w$ is in its scanning state, its input head is at position $t+1$, and its output consists of exactly $t$ zero bits.
replaced: For every fixed word $w$, every input $x$ and every $t \le |x|$: after $t$ steps from the initial configuration, the zero-prefixing emitter for $w$ is still in its scanner state, its input head is at position $t + 1$, and its output so far is $t$ zero bits.
